task_instance: Start the standalone Aspire Dashboard with `aspire dashboard run`, send an OTLP log record to it (simulating an OTLP-emitting app), and use the Aspire CLI's `aspire otel logs --dashboard-url <login-url>` command to retrieve/observe that telemetry, per the skill's 'Standalone Dashboard' and 'Local Commands Reference' workflow.
evidence: 1) Ran `aspire dashboard run --non-interactive --log-level Information` in background; CLI log (/root/.aspire/logs/cli_*.log) showed 'Now listening on: http://localhost:18888', OTLP/gRPC on :4317, OTLP/HTTP on :4318, and printed the login URL 'http://localhost:18888/login?t=<TOKEN>'. Verified reachability with `curl -L http://localhost:18888/login?t=<TOKEN>` -> HTTP 200. 2) POSTed a synthetic OTLP/HTTP JSON log payload (resource service.name=sample-service, message 'Hello from aspire-monitoring skill test') to http://localhost:4318/v1/logs -> HTTP 200 {}. 3) Confirmed ingestion via the dashboard's telemetry API (obtained api key from /api/telemetry/validateToken, then GET /api/telemetry/resources) -> [{"name":"sample-service",...,"hasLogs":true,...}]. 4) Ran the actual skill-documented command: `aspire otel logs sample-service --dashboard-url "http://localhost:18888/login?t=<TOKEN>" --format Json --non-interactive`, which returned: [{"logId":1,"message":"Hello from aspire-monitoring skill test","severity":"None","resourceName":"sample-service","attributes":{},"source":"sample-logger","dashboardUrl":"http://localhost:18888/structuredlogs?logEntryId=1"}] -- exactly matching the skill's documented monitoring workflow (dashboard run -> OTLP ingestion -> aspire otel logs --dashboard-url). Files: dashboard3.log (dashboard startup log), otel_logs3.json (CLI query result), otel_logs3.err (empty stderr). Note: `dotnet` CLI itself is not installed in this runtime, but the Aspire CLI ships its own bundled managed runtime (`/root/.aspire/versions/.../managed/aspire-managed`) so a full local .NET SDK was not needed for this observability/monitoring task; an AppHost-based scenario (aspire run/start + aspire logs/describe against a live AppHost) would additionally require project builds, which is out of scope for this monitoring-only skill's core deliverable (the standalone dashboard + otel query path), which was fully exercised and verified.
